description: Ranks 2 to 8 companies on the expectations gap: the owner-earnings growth each price requires (reverse DCF) minus the growth the business actually delivered over its last five fiscal years. Negative means the price asks for less than the company has already done. Per company: owner-earnings yield, return on tangible capital, ROE, gross margin first and last year, revenue and owner-earnings CAGR, the base used (latest year for a steady riser, an average for a cyclical) and a reading; refusals and do-not-extrapolate cases are labelled instead of ranked. The gap does not move with the hurdle the way absolute values do. Example: {"companies": [{"ticker": "KO", "price": 70.1}, {"ticker": "PEP", "price": 150.2}, {"ticker": "KDP", "price": 33.4}]}.

companies.description: Ticker and current share price for each company

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

hurdle_pct.description: Required return for the reverse DCF, % (default 8)

long_bond_pct.description: Long-bond yield in percent (5.4 = 5.4%). Default: the latest 30-year Treasury par yield, fetched from treasury.gov

name: compare_valuations
title: Compare valuations
